minh-dev: Hey @elaine-peopleops — small edge case. I'm remote in the UK but on the US payroll. Company shutdown is Dec 24-27 and there are UK bank holidays on Dec 27-28 this year. Can those UK bank holidays be moved into our floating holiday bank or treated as shutdown credit? Trying not to lose local statutory days.

elaine-peopleops: Short answer: we can often align local statutory days for remote employees, but it depends on payroll jurisdiction and contract. For US-payrolled remote folks in another country we either: 1) mark them as 'shutdown credit' (non-accrual paid days) or 2) convert to floating holidays if local law and payroll allow. We'll need a ticket + manager sign-off.

minh-dev: What's the exact form/process?

elaine-peopleops: Please submit People Portal -> Leave Exceptions -> "Local Holiday Alignment (Remote)". Include: country, local statutory dates, payroll jurisdiction, and whether you prefer "floating" or "shutdown credit". Example payload you can paste: ```Name: Minh Tran
Role: Software Eng (Remote - UK)
Payroll: US
Local statutory dates: Dec 27, Dec 28
Requested action: convert to floating holidays if payroll allows, else shutdown credit
Manager: Igor Petrov (igor-mgr)```

igor-mgr: I support this. Minh — submit and I'll approve immediately. We should try to get this into payroll before the Dec 15 cutoff if cash adjustment is needed.

payroll-bot: FYI payroll cutoff for cross-jurisdiction adjustments is Dec 15. After cutoff, only non-cash shutdown credits can be applied for the current year; cash payouts will be processed in Jan.

karen-hr: Note on carryover: if it's converted to floating holidays we can either add them to your current-year floating bank or mark them as separate 'local holiday credits' that do not impact carryover limits. If you want them to count toward next year's accrual, request 'carryover conversion' explicitly — approvals differ by country.

minh-dev: Prefer floating holidays that do not eat into carryover cap. Will request that in the portal.

elaine-peopleops: Great — once submitted label the ticket EX-2029-3010 and tag @igor-mgr. We'll aim to get payroll confirmation by Dec 14. If we miss payroll cutoff we'll grant shutdown credit separate from your PTO so you don't lose local statutory coverage.

igor-mgr: Approved in portal at 1939001250.

minh-dev: Submitted EX-2029-3010 with docs. Thanks everyone.

elaine-peopleops: Got it — EX-2029-3010 noted as "pending payroll review". Will update here when payroll confirms. Thanks for flagging early — remote folks are tricky across holiday windows.
